# Quality flags

A flag is not a rejection. The kernel stores what it was told and records
what is wrong with it — [invariant 4](../concepts/record-model.md#flag-never-reject)
— because a record refused at the door is a record that exists only in the
head of the person who was turned away.

These are the words shown to a credit officer. The renderer refuses to
display a flag that has no entry here, so this list and the product cannot
drift apart.

| Flag | What it means |
|---|---|
| `confirmed_by_organisational_bylaw` | confirmed by a cooperative officer under the cooperative’s own rules; the cooperative is one of the two parties to this delivery, so this is close to the seller confirming their own record |
| `confirmed_under_delegation` | confirmed by somebody acting for the other side rather than by the other side — weaker evidence, because the point of a confirmation is independence |
| `confirms_superseded_version` | the other side confirmed an earlier version of this delivery; the figure was corrected afterwards and the confirmation does not carry forward to the corrected one |
| `conversion_mismatch` | the stated kilograms do not equal the raw quantity times the cited factor — the two disagree and the record kept both |
| `conversion_scope_mismatch` | the factor was registered for a different commodity or a different district than the record it is used in — the kilogram figure is derived from the wrong rule |
| `conversion_unresolved` | the record cites no conversion, or one the registry does not hold; the kilogram figure cannot be checked at all |
| `delegated_authority` | somebody other than the subject asserted this, under a recorded delegation |
| `delegated_by_organisational_bylaw` | asserted by a cooperative officer under the cooperative’s own rules rather than an individual mandate |
| `mass_balance_discrepancy` | a lot released more or less than it took in, beyond the tolerance, after declared losses |
| `measurement_below_underwritable` | the quantity rests on a factor nobody has verified — usable for operations, not for lending against |
| `occurred_after_recorded` | the event is dated later than the moment it was written down — a clock problem, not necessarily a dishonest one |
| `quantity_not_normalized` | no kilogram figure was derived; the raw count stands alone |
| `region_unresolvable` | the factor is specific to a district and the record does not say which district it happened in; whether it applies cannot be determined either way |
